text:
Ryan Choi: Hey team — Ryan here, first day! :wave: coffee, kombucha, and an actual question: I brought a SCOBY and a 1L jar of brew. Is there a good spot in the SF office fridge? Also plant watering tips? Noticed a lot of succulents in the common area.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome @Ryan Choi! :tada: Quick reminders: badge pickup in 10am, desk 3B. Fridge policy: personal fermentables allowed if labeled and in sealed containers. Please limit to 2 items.
Maria Gómez: Welcome Ryan! Label it `ryan-SCOBY` and put it on the top shelf (left side) — less temp flux. I'll water the plants Tues if you want. :seedling:
Sophie Lee: Ooo kombucha! FYI we keep the bottom crisper clear for lunch stuff. Could you bring a spare lid or put it on a shallow tray? Re: plants — most are low-maintenance, but the fiddle leaf by the window likes a splash every ~10 days.
Jamal Aziz: If you leave it overnight try a shallow tray under it, we had a spill once :grimacing: Learned that the hard way.
Allison Park: Welcome! Lunch crew usually heads to Tuck at 12:30 — you should come. We do a tiny board-game break Wednesday too (15 mins).
Ryan Choi: Thanks all, label printed and taped. @Maria thanks for the plant help offer — I'll DM you. Also any best places to get a keffiyeh? (long story) :laughing:
Maria Gómez: Haha we have a small swap box in the kitchen corner, might find something there. If not, I can point you to a store in the Mission.
Sophie Lee: Quick fridge label template I use: ```text
Ryan | SCOBY | 3/10 | 415-555-0123
``` Keeps things readable.
Allison Park: Pinned the lunch note in #general. @Ryan, welcome again! :sparkles:
